Bad food, loud music.
Mar 2016 • Business
It was one of the worst restaurant meals I've had in a long time. I got the feeling that the kitchen staff were either drunk or didn't give a crap what they were feeding patrons. Clock in, throw some shiz on the grill, clock out.

Raw fin de claire oysters were warm, slimy, and definitely not fresh (not firm/crisp or chilled). Gnocchi was mushy like it was overcooked to eternity. Greek salad had browning lettuce leaves that were the size of the plate. Cheese had the texture of stale cardboard.

Only good thing about this meal was the view, the coconut drink, and my bottle of water. At least they didn't screw that up.

Even another white/Viet couple stormed out during my meal because the staff refused to turn down the music for them to talk. It was truly too loud. Staff here just don't care.

1 night stay- 170 USD- Big disappointment
Dec 2011
Eventhough we are living in HCMC, we stayed at the hotel for 1 night.
I had booked this hotel as a surprise for my bf and we were really looking forward to a romantic and nice weekend. Nothing else then good food, sun and relaxation.

We arrived with high expectations but I have experienced better stays in far lower priced hotels within Asia and far better food in HCMC.

The rooms are cute french style, with big wooden beds but very, very small and our room was very dark (pool view room 170 USD per night).

There were constructions around the hotel and lying on the pool was everything but relaxing. And that was actually why we stayed there: to escape the city noise.

We had dinner at the restaurant outside on the river. At this evening a big group of 20 people had their Xmas dinner there. Maybe that's why the staff was overwhelmed by too many guests. They didn't bring our starters, they brought wrong food, the salmon Carpaccio was warm.
I had a pizza which was below average.
The restaurant toilets? ... I couldn't even close the door!

I was very disappointed.

The breakfast the next morning was to be honest: a joke.
You can choose from around 5 breakfast options on the menue.
I had yogurt with fruits. Well, not much can go wrong with that.
My boyfriend had the egg Benedict which was nothing else but boring and tasteless and with this kind of processed ham which you can buy here in Coopmart.
The bread basket was tiny with 4 small pieces of bread and the worse: the baguette came frozen inside and we had to ask the staff many times to bring us new ones.

Especially with having great sources like Annam supermarket and Voelker bakery so close by, how can the food be so bad?! I'm wondering.

I don't know...maybe it was just bad luck and the whole weekend wasn't "our" weekend but we left very, very disappointed.

Looking back, I wouldn't go there again.
The pool view room (a tiny window towards the pool) was 170 USD per night (via agoda) and for that money you can also book a flight for 2 people to a nicer destination.

Sorry....
:(

After reading lots of wonderful reviews.....me and my finacee went down with high expectations on New Year Eve. Had our massage at Spa Authentic before heading down for dinner. Speechless........USD45???
Dec 2010
This restaurant is definitely over-rated! Decided to have my dinner at Villa Romaine after my massage session @Spa Authentic on New Year Eve(Happy and satisfied). Firstly, i was not advised on the buffet dinner. Initially, the ambience was quite romantic but the invited "band and singers" spoilt the mood ;( Me and my partner were frowning throughout the dinner. Buffet Spread is limited with only 4 sections: Salad, Pasta, BBQ and Dessert. Presentation is not impressive. Feels like "pot luck" outing. 1) Salad bar was not appealing and appetizing at all. My hotel breakfast salad spread is alot better. 
2) Pasta comes in Pene with few sauces to choose from; very average. 3) Italian BBQ is nothing great. Food selection and taste average. 4) Dessert corner is not satisfying; i supposed the "dragon fruit "is better than Tiramisu and choc cakes! The whole place was not fully crowded with guests leaving early and *yawning* Probably that's the best alfresco ambience you can find in HCM away from the busy city. I guessed the place is catered for resort guests and expats satying in Dist 2. Maybe its not my cup of tea..do manage your expectation if going. My 5 cents worth. ;0

Nice hide-away and great environment
When I first came here for a business meeting, the fantastic sight of the restaurant attracted to come back. And it was just wonderful they have boat service from District 1 directly to the restaurant, called Saigon River Express or sth similar. It is not cheap compared with a 15-minute cab, yet the experience is really good.
The food and service are just average. But what I love there is a fantastic river view, a good chance to have a leisure time away from the busy city center. So if you look for a unique experience, this is a must-try.
1 Caesar salad, 1 Fillet Steak Forestiera, 1 Margherita Pizza, 1 Spaghetti Carbonara, 1 Tuscan Soup, 1 San Pellegrino and a bottle of Yalumba. Total is 60$ for 2 people.

Romantic but...
This is a very romantic spot to go for dinner- equally popular with wealthy Vietnamese and well-heeled tourists staying at the hotel or tripping out from District 1.

The river backdrop to the palazzo hotel certainly adds atmosphere.

Service is attentive, but too tutored and not natural- not unique in that respect.

Spaghetti with shrimp and zucchini, Spaghetti with clams and french beans- both very average. The clam dish was a replacement for the carbonara which was first ordered but came as scrambled egg through spaghetti- and it was still on the bill a the end of the meal!

In fairness, the manager deducted it when I made it clear that I wouldn't pay and did offer coffee or desert- we passed.

Maybe just as well as I was ill as soon as I got home.

1 shared antipasti, 2 pasta dishes and a bottle of Argentinian Malbec 1m VND / c. $50- looks good but think VN value!

Not likely to return, regrettably.

Surely the best Italian restaurant in HCMC
This place is surely the best Italian in the city (not that there are that many nice one in the first place). The outdoor seating is one of the most romantic and relaxing setting that we had dinner at in recent years (except of course Bali ...) and the food was very good with one of the best wine lists I have seen anywhere at what I would consider bargain prices (they must have made a mistake on conversion or bought the wines 10 years ago!). 
The service is quite good but some of the waiters don't speak very good English, but then again we sort of got used to that even in 5 star hotels in Vietnam. Overall this is a must for any sort of romantic dinner (they had candles but they kept getting blown out by the breeze coming from the river) away from the chaos of the city center. It takes about 10-15 minutes from the Opera house and costs about 40 HKD.

Perfect location, thats about it!
Beautiful locaiton and surroundings! However, totally ruined by food below average and no service whatsoever! The young waiter spoke hardly any english at all, and came wisely back to reconfirm orders.

Took us at least 20 minutes after we were seated to even get some water (they were not busy). Said we wanted drinks first, they came after the food was served. Also got the wrong wine, but gave up discussing with the waiter (we paid for the more expensive one).

Had fresh linguini with clamps, 5 out of 10 - 12 were not opened - should these be served at all? Continued with Crispy Duck, tasty but chewey and never saw any crispyness! Ended at not so very nich meel with terrible Tiramisu, they do not serve them like that in Italy!

Have you ever been to an Italian restaurant with no Pepper Mill? (was hard to even explain what we wanted!)

Also, such a great location could do with some upgrade of guest toilets.

Gorgeous outdoor terrace
if you miss European food after a few days in Vietnam enjoying the local delicacies this please is perfect, very decent Italian food for Vietnam, probably one of the best in town. The thing that makes this place really special is the beautiful terrace overlooking the river. The restaurant is a little bit outside the main business/tourist district but it is by no means a bad ride and well worth the wait. The food is not 100% Italian taste but very good quality. The colonial style boutique hotel which serves as a background to the restaurant and the Bossa Nova chilled music and candle-light tables made for a great atmosphere for a date, romantic evening or just a chilled out dinner. We will certainly be back!
